(u.tipo='usuario' OR u.team_gym_id IS NOT NULL)))) AND ((NEW.event_type='origin_declared' AND NEW.source_id=COALESCE(NEW.client_id,NEW.owner_id) AND NEW.source_version=COALESCE((SELECT max(x.source_version) FROM public.product_analytics_facts x WHERE x.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND x.context=NEW.context AND x.client_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.client_id AND x.event_type='origin_declared'),0)+1) OR (NEW.event_type='plan_saved' AND NEW.source_version=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.planes_generados p WHERE CAST(p.id AS TEXT)=NEW.source_id AND
